title: Partition flips induce a noise kernel
statement: Let $n,m$ be natural numbers with $m>0$, choose a label $j$ among the $m$ labels, and fix a sign vector $x$ on $n$ coordinates. Choose uniformly a map from the $n$ coordinates to the $m$ labels, and negate $x_i$ exactly at coordinates mapped to $j$. The resulting random sign vector has the noise-kernel distribution with correlation parameter $1-2/m$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector on $n$ coordinates
